extraction.name: MATHVISTA
extraction.description: A benchmark designed to combine challenges from diverse mathematical and visual tasks, consisting of 6,141 examples derived from 28 existing multimodal datasets and 3 newly created datasets (IQTest, FunctionQA, PaperQA).
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Hritik Bansal, Tony Xia, Jiacheng Liu, Chunyuan Li, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Hao Cheng, Kai-Wei Chang, Michel Galley, Jianfeng Gao
extraction.citeAs: Lu et al., 2024, MATHVISTA: EVALUATING MATHEMATICAL REASONING OF FOUNDATION MODELS IN VISUAL CONTEXTS, ICLR 2024
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected from 28 existing multimodal datasets (9 MathQA and 19 VQA datasets) and 3 newly created datasets (IQTest, FunctionQA, PaperQA). For existing datasets, examples were limited to up to 400 per source. For VQA datasets, heuristic rules were used to automatically select math-related examples, followed by manual labeling by three expert annotators. New datasets were manually annotated by graduate students in STEM fields with a two-step review process.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Web Scraping
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Source datasets include 9 MathQA datasets (e.g., Geometry3K, GeoQA+, GEOS, UniGeo, CLEVR-Math, IconQA, TabMWP, SciBench, TheoremQA) and 19 VQA datasets (e.g., ChartQA, FigureQA, DVQA, MapQA, PlotQA, DocVQA, AI2D, ScienceQA, TQA, A-OKVQA, KVQA, ParsVQA-Caps, TextVQA, VizWiz, VQA2.0, PMC-VQA, VQA-RAD, Super-CLEVR, VQA-AS). New datasets: IQTest (puzzle test figures from online learning platforms), FunctionQA (functional plots), PaperQA (academic figures from Huggingface papers).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For VQA datasets, heuristic rules (numeric answers or quantity words) were used to automatically select math-related examples, then manually labeled by three expert annotators. Majority voting was used to finalize examples. Each source dataset limited to 400 examples. New datasets were manually annotated and reviewed.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For new datasets (IQTest, FunctionQA, PaperQA), questions were manually annotated by graduate students in STEM fields. A two-step process: each dataset independently annotated by three reviewers, with inter-annotation consistency rate of 99.2%. Discrepancies resolved through discussion. For metadata annotation, mathematical reasoning categories were automatically annotated from source dataset details and verified by human annotators on 1,000 examples (94.1% agreement).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Inter-annotator agreement for mathematical reasoning labeling: 94.1% exact match, 98.79% individual label agreement. For VQA selection, Fleiss Kappa score of 0.775 (substantial agreement).
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Graduate students in STEM fields for new dataset annotation. For human performance baseline, annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk with high school diploma or higher, satisfactory annotating history, and passing qualification examples.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The test set answer labels will not be publicly released to prevent data contamination. An online evaluation platform will be maintained.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset coverage may have gaps in certain mathematical problems and visuals. Scalability and generalizability to other domains remain a concern. Only 85.6% of examples have annotations due to heterogeneity of sources. Annotations lack unified format and structure.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning. Benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning in visual contexts for foundation models.
